caption: The drawing depicts an aerial view of a garden or park, divided into multiple triangular and rectangular sections by sandy-colored paths that intersect and curve throughout the composition. Each section is filled with an array of plants and flowers in various colors, including patches of yellow, red, orange, pink, white, and green. The upper part of the image is bordered by a curved path and partial fence, with a few trees sketched outside the main garden area. At the lower center, a circular cluster of taller green trees is surrounded by a path forming a roundabout. Several sections contain dense, geometrically organized flower beds, while others have more scattered flowering plants. To the mid-right, two rectangular fields with parallel rows of orange and green are depicted, accompanied by a small shed-like structure nearby. A prominent purple and red flowering tree dominates the lower right quadrant, with its canopy extending over part of the central path. Various smaller trees and bushes are distributed along the paths and borders, and the background and outer edges are filled with green to indicate grassy areas. The illustration is bordered by a plain beige frame.
